cards.flavor_text: "If you think losing is the best teacher, you should really give winning a try."

cards.name: Baron Nashor (Ultimate)
cards.description:
As you play me, add the Baron Pit battlefield token to the board if it's not there already. If you do, I enter there.
I can't be chosen by enemy spells and abilities.
Other friendly units have +2 Might.

cards.name: Sprite Burst
cards.description: Play two ready 3 Might Sprite unit tokens with [TEMPORARY]. (Kill each at the start of its controller's Beginning Phase, before scoring.)
cards.flavor_text: They're lovely, while they last.

cards.name: Safety Inspector
cards.description:
You may spend 3 XP as an additional cost to play me.
When you play me, each player must kill one of their units. If you paid my additional cost, you don't kill a unit this way.
cards.flavor_text: "Looks fine to me!"

cards.name: Divining Shells
cards.description:
[VISION] (When you play this, look at the top card of your Main Deck. You may recycle it.)
[ACTION] Kill this, Exhaust, Give a unit +2 Might this turn.
cards.flavor_text: Today's treasure is tomorrow's trash.

cards.name: Kinkou Initiate
cards.description: When you play me, draw 1 if your other units have total Might 5 or more
cards.flavor_text: True strength lifts up others.

cards.name: Ruined Rex
cards.description: [DEATHKNELL] Deal 4 to an enemy unit. (When I die, get the effect.)
cards.flavor_text: It's back, and worse than ever.

cards.name: Skyward Strike
cards.description:
Move an enemy unit.
[LEVEL 6] [STUN] an enemy unit. (While you have 6+ XP, get the effect. A stunned unit doesn't deal combat damage this turn.)
cards.flavor_text: Take a moment to heel up.

cards.name: Arena Kingpin
cards.description:
I enter ready.
Exhaust: Give a unit +3 Might this turn.
cards.flavor_text: Don't you dare suggest it's a hairpiece.

cards.name: Scorchclaw
cards.description:
[HUNT 2] (When I conquer or hold, gain 2 XP.)
[LEVEL 3] I have +1 Might and enter ready. (While you have 3+ XP, get the effect.)
cards.flavor_text: "Sit. Stay. Burn."

cards.name: Monster Harpoon
cards.description:
[ACTION] (Play on your turn or in showdowns.)
Deal 2 to a unit at a battlefield. If you control a facedown card, deal 4 to it instead.
cards.flavor_text: "Ready" and "fire" are easy. Aiming, now that's the hard part.

cards.name: Alpha Wildclaw
cards.description:
[TANK] (I must be assigned combat damage first.)
Your units here with less Might than me can't be chosen by enemy spells and abilities.
cards.flavor_text: Best take care of the big one, before it takes care of you.

cards.name: Smoke and Mirrors
cards.description:
[Hidden] (Hide now for 1 Rune to react with later for 0.)
[ACTION] (Play on your turn or in showdowns.)
Choose a unit you control and another unit you control at a different location. If at least one of them has [TEMPORARY], move each to the other's location. Draw 1.

cards.name: Nami - Headstrong
cards.description:
You may pay 1 Calm as an additional cost to play me.
When you play me, if you paid the additional cost, [STUN] an enemy unit. (It doesn't deal combat damage this turn.)
When I hold, the next time you play a unit this turn, ready it and [BUFF] it.

cards.name: Maduli the Gatekeeper
cards.description:
I can't be readied.
1 Chaos: Move me to an occupied enemy battlefield if my Might is greater than the total Might of enemy units there.
cards.flavor_text:
"... Made a song so eerie, thought I'd die."
—Old Gaff's tale

cards.name: Vex - Apathetic
cards.description:
[DEFLECT] (Opponents must pay 1 Rune to choose me with a spell or ability.)
When an opponent plays a unit while I'm at a battlefield, [STUN] it. They can't move it this turn. (It doesn't deal combat damage this turn.)
cards.flavor_text: "I'll show them the meaning of apathy. Or not."

cards.name: Vex - Apathetic (Alternate Art)
cards.description:
[DEFLECT]
When an opponent plays a unit while I'm at a battlefield, [STUN] it. They can't move it this turn.
cards.flavor_text: "I'll show them the meaning of apathy. Or not."

cards.name: Altar of Blood
cards.description: If a unit here would die during combat, its controller may pay 3 Runes to heal it, exhaust it, and recall it instead.

cards.name: Amateur Recital
cards.description: When you hold here, you may move a unit at a battlefield to its base.

cards.name: Square Up
cards.description:
[REPEAT] - Discard 1 (You may pay the additional cost to repeat this spell's effect.)
Give a unit [ASSAULT 4] this turn. (+4 Might while it's an attacker.)
cards.flavor_text: Nothing like a good roar to work up an appetite for violence.

cards.name: Double Trouble
cards.description:
[REPEAT 2] (You may pay the additional cost to repeat this spell's effect.)
Look at the top 3 cards of your Main Deck. You may reveal a unit from among them and draw it. Recycle the rest.
cards.flavor_text: Two heads pay better than one.

cards.name: Flurry of Feathers
cards.description:
[REACTION] (Play any time, even before spells and abilities resolve.)
Choose one —
• Counter a spell
• Play four 1 Might Bird unit tokens with [DEFLECT] (Opponent's must pay 1 Rune to choose them with a spell or ability.)

cards.name: Trevor Snoozebottom
cards.description:
[SHIELD] (+1 Might while I'm a defender.)
When I hold, play a ready 3 Might Sprite token with [TEMPORARY] here. (Kill it at the start of its controller's next Beginning Phase, before scoring.)
cards.flavor_text: He's raised sleepwalking to an art form.

cards.name: Moonlight Affliction
cards.description:
[REACTION] (Play any time, even before spells and abilities resolve.)
Give a unit -10 Might this turn.
cards.flavor_text: Light can illuminate, or it can blind.

cards.name: Spectral Centaur
cards.description: When another friendly unit dies, give me +2 Might this turn.
cards.flavor_text: Death provides him with an ever-growing herd.

cards.name: Chakram Dancer
cards.description:
[AMBUSH] (You may play me as a [REACTION] to a battlefield where you have units.)
When you play me, give your other units here [SHIELD] this turn. (+1 Might while they're defenders.)
cards.flavor_text: Elegant. Effortless. Deadly.

cards.name: Imposing Challenger
cards.description: When I move, you may move an enemy unit here with less Might than me to a different battlefield.
cards.flavor_text: "Are there truly none with the courage to face our new champion?"

cards.name: Grim Apothecary
cards.description:
[AMBUSH] (You may play me as a [REACTION] to a battlefield where you have units.)
When you play me, you may return a friendly unit at a battlefield to its owner's hand.
cards.flavor_text: The cure is better than the disease, but not by much.

cards.name: Katarina - Reckless
cards.description:
When you hide a card, ready me.
When you play a card from face down, deal 2 to an enemy unit.
cards.flavor_text: "Keep friends close and enemies guessing."

cards.name: Wuju Apprentice
cards.description:
[HUNT] (When I conquer or hold, gain 1 XP.)
[LEVEL 6] When you play me, draw 1. (While you have 6+ XP, get the effect.)
cards.flavor_text: "I've learned a great deal during my apprenticeship. Allow me to demonstrate."

cards.name: Allay, Eager Admirer
cards.description:
[DEFLECT] (Opponents must pay 1 Rune to choose me with a spell or ability.)
While I'm at a battlefield, your other units here have [DEFLECT].
cards.flavor_text: "Hey, Vex! Look what I've got! It's a surprise! For you! Aren't you excited?!"

cards.name: Vex - Mocking
cards.description:
[SHIELD] (+1 Might while I'm a defender.)
[TANK] (I must be assigned combat damage first.)
When you [STUN] an enemy unit at a battlefield, you may move me to that battlefield.
cards.flavor_text: "Let's turn these smiles upside down."

cards.name: Vex - Mocking (Alternate Art)
cards.description:
[SHIELD]
[TANK]
When you [STUN] an enemy unit at a battlefield, you may move me to that battlefield.
cards.flavor_text: "Let's turn these smiles upside down."

cards.name: Keeper of Masks
cards.description:
[HIDDEN] (Hide now for 1 Rune to react with later for 0.)
[TEMPORARY] (Kill me at the start of my controller's Beginning Phase, before scoring.)
When you play me, play two Reflection unit tokens here. They become copies of me.

cards.name: Lillia - Fae Fawn
cards.description:
[ACCELERATE] (You may pay 1 + 1 Calm as an additional cost to have me enter ready.)
When I move from a location, play a 3 Might Sprite unit token with [TEMPORARY] there. (Kill it at the start of its controller's Beginning Phase, before scoring.)

cards.name: Lillia - Fae Fawn (Alternate Art)
cards.description:
[ACCELERATE]
When I move from a location, play a 3 Might Sprite unit token with [TEMPORARY] there.

cards.name: Towering Combatant
cards.description:
[SHIELD 2] (+2 Might while I'm a defender.)
[TANK] (I must be assigned combat damage first.)
cards.flavor_text: "Was this really your plan, pal?"

cards.name: Repulse
cards.description:
[REACTION] (Play any time, even before spells and abilities resolve.)
Choose a friendly unit at a battlefield. Counter an enemy spell or ability that chooses it and no other friendly unit.

cards.name: Clash of Giants
cards.description: Choose two units. They deal damage equal to their Mights to each other.
cards.flavor_text:
"The land slumbers, but it is not dead. With my roar, I wake it. With my thunder, I call it."
—Volibear

cards.name: Irresistible Faefolk
cards.description: Choose two units. They deal damage equal to their Mights to each other.
cards.flavor_text: Cute, yes. Cuddly, no.

cards.name: Arachnoid Horror
cards.description:
[HUNT 2] (When I conquer or hold, gain 2 XP.)
I can be played to an occupied battlefield if an enemy unit is alone there.
Friendly units can be played to an occupied battlefield if an enemy unit is alone there.
cards.flavor_text: Don't go alone.

cards.name: Lunar Boon
cards.description:
[REACTION] (Play any time, even before spells and abilities resolve.)
Discard 1, then draw 2.
cards.flavor_text:
"A new moon is rising."
—Diana

cards.name: Vicious Snapjaws
cards.description: When another friendly unit dies, gain 1 XP.
cards.flavor_text: They don't know friend or foe, only food.

cards.name: Angler Beast
cards.description: When you play me, return all units with 2 Might or less to their owners' hands.
cards.flavor_text:
"There's plenty of room for everyone at the bottom of the sea."
—Pyke

cards.name: Scryer's Bloom
cards.description:
This enters exhausted.
Kill this, 1, Exhaust: [PREDICT 2], then draw 1. Gain 1 XP. (To Predict 2, look at the top two cards of your Main Deck. Recycle any of them and put the rest back in any order.)
cards.flavor_text: Not all foliage conceals.

cards.name: Conscription
cards.description:
You may spend 5 XP as an additional cost to play this.
Choose an enemy unit at a battlefield with 3 Might or less. If you paid the additional cost, choose any enemy unit at a battlefield instead. Take control of it, exhaust it, and recall it.

cards.name: Syndra - Transcendent
cards.description: While I'm in a showdown, your spells have [REPEAT 2 + 1 Chaos]. (You may pay the additional cost to repeat the spell's effect.)
cards.flavor_text: "This power is mine to command."

cards.name: Bandle Soldier
cards.description: [LEVEL 3] I enter ready. (While you have 3+ XP, get the effect.)
cards.flavor_text: Bandle Scout Rule 170: Everything makes you better at everything.

cards.name: Carrion Dredger
cards.description: [DEATHKNELL] Play a 1 Might Bird unit token with [DEFLECT] to your base. (When I die, get the effect. Opponents must pay 1 Rune to choose a [DEFLECT] unit with a spell or ability.)
cards.flavor_text: The automaton paused and stared in wonder. Amidst the detritus sat a single unbroken egg.

cards.name: Shepherd's Heirloom
cards.description:
When you play this, gain 1 XP.
[EQUIP] — Spend 1 XP (Pay the cost: Attach this to a unit you control.)
cards.flavor_text: "Even the sheep can tell it's special. And sheep aren't very smart."

cards.name: Soul Harvest
cards.description: Kill a unit at a battlefield with 3 Might or less.
cards.flavor_text: It won't hurt a bit—it'll hurt a LOT.

cards.name: Shard of Undoing
cards.description: The first time a friendly unit dies during your Beginning Phase each turn, each opponent must kill one of their units.
cards.flavor_text: Treasure is eternal. It's life that's fleeting.

cards.name: Valley of Idols
cards.description: When a player plays a unit here, they may pay to [BUFF] it. (Give it a +1 Might buff if it doesn't have one.)
